name: github_create_branch
description: Create a new branch in a repository by creating a git ref. First get the base commit SHA with github_get_ref (e.g. of 'main'), then call this with `ref` set to the FULL ref name 'refs/heads/<new-branch>' and `sha` set to that base SHA. Provide `owner`, `repo`, `ref`, `sha`.

sha.description: The commit SHA the new branch should point at (from github_get_ref).
